verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection/risk-scoring SaaS product for businesses, not an AI-native developer tool or agent with its own telemetry collection about usage of the tool itself; opting out of 'telemetry/usage tracking' as a user-facing privacy control is a category mismatch — Sift's entire business model is collecting user behavioral data for fraud analysis, which is the opposite axis (a customer/privacy-compliance question, not a product feature toggle for AI-native tool users).
